# 2026 holiday iPhone 18 Pro deals: Simplicity Plan & loyalty perks

## At a glance


-


Purchase iPhone 18 Pro now and get Apple Watch SE 3 and AirPods 5 on us with a new watch line when you switch to Verizon.


-


No activation or upgrade fees when you enroll in Verizon Loyalty.


## Why Verizon is the best choice for the latest iPhone


Purchase[iPhone 18 Pro now with no trade-in required when you sign up for Simplicity Plan](https://vz.to/vz1141) . For a limited time, you can also get Apple Watch SE 3 and AirPods 5 on us. A watch with a new service plan is required in order to receive AirPods 5 (min. $7.50/mo w/Auto Pay, +taxes/fees, for 36 mos). Plus zero activation or upgrade fees when enrolled in Verizon Loyalty. iPhone 18 Pro, alongside iPhone 18 Pro Max, delivers the most advanced pro camera system in an iPhone, with huge leaps in battery life and performance.


## What does the Simplicity Plan cost, and what do I get?


Here’s what the service costs and what comes with it:


-


**Simplicity Plan:** $45 per month per line with Auto Pay, or $30 per month per line if you switch to Verizon, also with Auto Pay. Device not included.


-


**Your network access:** Every line includes 5G Ultra Wideband, there’s no higher network tier you need to buy.


-


**A connection for your other devices:** You get 10 GB of mobile hotspot data, so you can use your phone to connect a laptop or tablet when you’re away from Wi-Fi.


-


**Your choice of extras:** You can add discounted[streaming and storage perks](https://www.verizon.com/products-perks/perks/) . Start with the services your household already uses and compare what you’re paying now.


## What perks do I get with Verizon Loyalty?


Verizon Loyalty members get 3% cash back in Verizon Dollars and no activation or upgrade fees, which saves up to $40 per device. Join[Verizon Loyalty](https://www.verizon.com/loyalty/) for free in the My Verizon app.


You also get:


-


**3% back each month in Verizon Dollars.** You can use your rewards to shop with Verizon, get gift cards or transfer to other loyalty programs. Verizon Visa Card holders can also put those rewards toward their Verizon bill.


-


**Verizon Shine rewards.** Enter weekly on the my Verizon app for a chance to win once-in-a-lifetime experiences, alongside daily drops including tickets to concerts and sporting events, luxury merchandise, dining vouchers, gift cards and more.


## About iPhone 18 Pro


**iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max** offer the new 48MP Fusion Main camera with variable aperture, the most advanced camera Apple has ever made, and new Pro controls let users customize their experience. Powered by A20 Pro, iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max deliver huge leaps in battery life and performance. iPhone 18 Pro models feature[Apple Intelligence](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/06/apple-intelligence-brings-powerful-ai-capabilities-into-everyday-experiences/)¹


and[Siri AI](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2026/06/apple-introduces-siri-ai-a-profoundly-more-capable-and-personal-assistant/)²


, an entirely new version of Siri, rolling out in beta in English with iOS 27, to bring AI capabilities together with a user’s personal context to become an intelligent personal hub with privacy and security at the core. iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max are available in four elegant finishes: black, silver, glacier, and an all-new burgundy.


[Learn more details on pricing.](https://vz.to/vz1141)


## Frequently asked questions about purchasing iPhone at Verizon


Why should I buy my iPhone from Verizon?


Switching to Simplicity Plan from Verizon allows you to purchase iPhone 18 Pro with no trade-in needed, plus for a limited time, get Apple Watch SE 3 and AirPods 5, and the ability to get the latest iPhone every year. A watch with a new service plan (min. $7.50/mo w/Auto Pay, +taxes/fees, for 36 mos) is required in order to receive AirPods 5 . When you enroll in Verizon Loyalty, you avoid activation and upgrade fees.


How do I get Apple Watch SE 3 and AirPods 5 on us?


Purchase iPhone 18 Pro on Simplicity and receive Apple Watch SE 3 on us with a new line on a $7.50/mo watch plan (for 36 mos, plus taxes/fees; 0% APR. Add’l terms apply.). A $300 promo credit will be applied over 36 months. After account eligibility is confirmed the AirPods 5 will be available to be redeemed via a myOffers link.


Does the $45 Simplicity Plan price include the Auto Pay discount?


Yes. The Verizon Simplicity Plan costs $45 per month per line with Auto Pay, plus taxes and fees.


Do I have to switch to Verizon to get the $30 Simplicity price?


Yes. The $30 per month per line Simplicity price is for customers who switch to Verizon and use Auto Pay, plus taxes and fees.


Can I trade in a phone with a cracked screen?


Verizon appraises the market value of your device based on make, model and condition. You may also be eligible for additional trade-in value depending on new or existing promotions. The quickest way to find out about your eligibility for trade-in credit is to visit Verizon’s[Device Trade-In page](https://www.verizon.com/trade-in/) and enter info about your device and its condition to get a preliminary offer—you’ll be notified of the final value of a credit after Verizon receives your device. To learn more about the process, check out[this step-by-step how-to guide](https://www.verizon.com/support/how-to-recycle-device/) .


How do Verizon Dollars work?


Verizon Loyalty members earn 3% cash back every month in Verizon Dollars. You can use Verizon Dollars to spend on Verizon products or transfer to other loyalty programs.


What fees are waived for those enrolled in Verizon Loyalty?


Verizon Loyalty members pay no activation or upgrade fees on a new device, which saves up to $40 per device.
